description:
List support tickets

Returns the account's support tickets, newest first, with no paging. By default only open work is listed: tickets in state `closed` or `resolved` are left out unless you ask for them. Pass `includeArchived=true` to get exactly the closed and resolved ones instead, or `status` to filter to a single state. `includeArchived` takes precedence over `status` when both are sent. Neither parameter is validated against a fixed list, so a misspelled `status` is not an error, it simply matches no tickets and returns an empty array.

includeArchived.description: Set to `true` to list the archive, meaning exactly the `closed` and `resolved` tickets, instead of the open ones. Only the literal string `true` has any effect; every other value, including `false`, leaves the default behaviour in place.

status.description: Return only tickets in this state. The states in use are `open`, `in_progress`, `waiting`, `resolved` and `closed`. Not validated: an unrecognised value matches nothing. Ignored when `includeArchived=true` is also sent.
